name: Progress MS-28
about: Progress MS-28 (2024-145A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2024 Aug 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Aug 16), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
